sources.finding: The documented --commit flag is Git-backed only; --image selects an image-backed tag or digest.
commitId is a Git SHA. imageUrl is for image-backed services. Image host/repository/name must match the configured image. Generic400 is documented but is not proof of the exact image+commit error.

Image input accepts tags or digests and defaults omitted Docker Hub host/library/latest components. Public registries must be reachable; private registry support is listed. Local private/trusted-registry restrictions are Bex installation policy, not universal OCI grammar.
Reference grammar separates lowercase repository paths from tags; uppercase tag characters are legal.
Known digest validation checks encoded hexadecimal syntax and algorithm-specific encoded length.
Pinned v0.6.0 separates lowercase path components and uppercase-capable tags; go-digest enforces SHA25664/SHA512128 lowercase hex lengths.

local_contracts.finding: Specific-commit action already gated to repo-backed non-cron; image service uses latest-image action and restart.
GraphQL hook forwards commitId/deployMode/clearCache and renders server mutation error. No imageUrl option is exposed in this hook.
Current dashboard TriggerDeploy mutation leaves imageUrl out. Backend schema still exposes it to direct clients.
Blueprint services[].image.url maps into CreateRequest.Image, reaching shared image validation.
GraphQL triggerDeploy forwards commitId/imageUrl to common Trigger.
REST CreateDeploy JSON forwards commitId/imageUrl to common Trigger.

pinned_cli.contract: Noninteractive --commit and --image become JSON commitId/imageUrl without source-type validation. Interactive setupForm uses ImagePath to show image input or commit input. Both exact-pin binaries can therefore test server rejection.
